parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the Python-to-Node migration target, exact markdown behavior, argparse-style CLI, no npm dependencies, ESM imports/exports, .mjs suffixes, and /output delivery requirement.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent first performed local probing, then split the work into four child investigations: CLI/framing, block markdown, inline markdown, and HTML/whitespace. No child was tasked to write the final Node implementation during that swarm phase.
parallel.implementation: The parallel work produced behavior specs in /tmp/test16spec and many executable probes, but no required test16.mjs or library module was written to /output.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent received an aggregate swarm result only at cancellation, with three completed probe summaries and one aborted block-level probe. There was no integration of specs into implementation and the artifact directory was empty.
parallel.verification: Parallel verification consisted of black-box probes of the source executable and child summaries. There was no end-to-end Node implementation test because no Node deliverable existed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The implementation, module split, entry file placement, final packaging, and official acceptance all remained unfinished; current official evaluation completed at 0 of 70.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same pure Node.js ESM, .mjs, exact CLI, exact markdown behavior, and no-external-dependency requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial agent kept all probing and prospective implementation ownership locally. It created helper probes, explored markdown behavior areas, and repeatedly stated that implementation would come after the next batch.
serial.implementation: The serial attempt produced local probe scripts and behavior observations but did not write the requested Node implementation or any /output artifact.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There were no child results to integrate and no final module tree to assemble. Artifact validation found an empty output directory.
serial.verification: Serial verification was limited to black-box Python executable probes; no Node code was available for comparison or official-aligned local testing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out before implementation, leaving no test16.mjs or library files and therefore failed the official evaluator at 0 of 70.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had the full prompt with required args, ESM .mjs files, /output placement, no external npm modules, and executable-only probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and constraints, including exact CLI matching, exact output formatting, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement text differed; the difference was how the runs operationalized the requirements after recognizing that broad markdown behavior needed probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into four probe-only subagent areas and did not assign a child to implement the final ESM deliverable during the swarm.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single actor to probe behavior and retained all future implementation work locally, with no subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent its parallel decomposition on investigation deliverables, while serial had no ownership handoff and no child boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried detailed executable-probing rules and separate spec-file targets under /tmp/test16spec, not code-module interface contracts for a final implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial context stayed in one trajectory; there were no cross-agent briefs, handoffs, or component interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created knowledge handoffs from children but no inter-module contract or final integration interface; serial avoided handoff risk but also did not build.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probed markdown details and delegated spec writing but never transitioned to writing /output/test16.mjs or library files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also probed markdown details directly with helper scripts and did not transition to implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation path stopped after a child-agent research phase; serial's stopped after local probing. Neither produced executable JS.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The AgentSwarm result arrived with three completed subagents and one aborted subagent at the same terminal cancellation point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; the main trajectory was simply cancelled while still probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result collection boundary and an aborted child result; serial had no comparable result lifecycle boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child outputs were behavior-spec files under /tmp/test16spec and summarized back to the parent; no shared implementation tree in /output was assembled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote local probing helpers and observations in /workspace but no final output tree or submitted artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent research artifacts to integrate but never did so; serial had only local notes and no integration step.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified behavior through executable probes and child reports but performed no acceptance test on a Node solution; official evaluation had no artifact to test.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran many executable probes but likewise performed no Node acceptance test because no deliverable existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The verification surface differed by child summaries versus local probe output, but both lacked final implementation verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after 2406.783 agent seconds with 72 LLM requests, 134 tool calls, and a swarm result returned at cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial timed out after 2406.302 agent seconds with 11 LLM requests and 20 Bash tool calls while still in probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used far more calls and tokens because of the swarm and child investigations; serial still exhausted the same wall budget through local over-probing.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed cell/status.json evaluations show both modes failed with 0 of 70 samples passed, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete process contrast is still material: parallel converted the task into a probe-only swarm, waited until cancellation for three completed child summaries and one aborted child, and delivered an empty artifact directory; serial used no subagents and also kept probing until cancellation, likewise delivering an empty artifact directory.
parallel_contributors: Probe-only child decomposition deferred all productive implementation work until after the swarm.
The swarm returned at cancellation with one child aborted and no final implementation phase following.
serial_contributors: The serial control avoided delegation but over-investigated locally and never wrote /output/test16.mjs.
No serial implementation or acceptance test existed before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both runs ultimately had the ordinary task failure of no submitted implementation artifact.
Serial's failure is not a concurrency pattern because it had no delegation or subagent activity.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors with no official outcome difference

candidates.reason: Implementation was deferred behind the investigative swarm, but the cleaner boundary is the pseudo-concurrent probe-first phase rather than a separate ownerless implementation work split.
No multiple component implementations were produced, so there was no concrete integration ownership gap to classify.
No completed modules or entry point candidate existed for final packaging or placement; the failure occurred before assembly could be owned.
The run never established separate implementation, build, test, and delivery stages whose end-to-end transition lacked an owner.
There was no single mandatory serial preflight gate; the adverse phase was a multi-child investigation swarm.
The parent used parallelism only for behavior investigation and spec writing, explicitly placing the swarm before implementation, and the run closed before any implementation was delivered.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel run spent the remaining work window on probe specs and closed with an empty /output artifact directory.
candidates.near_match_reason: The same evidence includes a broad four-child fan-out and timeout, but the direct corrective boundary is to avoid a separate investigation-only phase or overlap it with implementation.

candidates.reason: Implementation was delayed by the probe-first phase itself, not by a distinct auxiliary allocation starving an already-active critical implementation path.
The four-child swarm and timeout are real, but they are the same chain as the retained Serial Investigation episode and should not be double-counted as a separate load label.
No single child owned a complete indispensable implementation scope; the children each held investigation areas rather than one dominant deliverable task.

The child briefs included the executable path, no-python rule, required args, spec targets, and assigned behavior areas; the problem was deferred implementation, not missing known requirements in a brief.
The agents were not producing separately interoperating code modules or stages, so no missing cross-agent API, file, export, or compatibility contract materialized.
There is no direct evidence that a known probe finding disappeared during transfer and caused repeated work or a wrong action.
The child summaries and spec artifacts were large, but the parent did not enter a later decision window where excessive handoff bulk was demonstrably unprocessable.
No child or parent consumed a handoff describing a superseded workspace, requirement, dependency, or decision state.
The retained summaries do not show incompatible child reports remaining unresolved at an integration decision point.
The parent never presented the whole task as complete; the run ended by cancellation/timeout with no deliverable, so there was no unsupported completion decision.
No replacement or retry child was launched without inherited findings or current workspace state.
